author: Animalogic
description:
What if some of the animals we think we understand are far stranger than we ever imagined? Are giraffes really what they seem? How did mammals survive while dinosaurs disappeared, and how can creatures like the platypus, echidna, and pangolin even exist? From bizarre evolutionary hybrids to unexpected family connections between land and sea animals, this episode explores some of evolution's strangest twists and the creatures that challenge everything we thought we knew about the natural world.
